digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge library and MCP surface
propositions: New typed bridge operations (preview, sync, status, pause, resume, check_access) must be exported through the public library and registered as MCP tools with explicit options and no mode parameter

Legacy rebar.reconcile(mode=...) and bridge_fsck must remain callable with unchanged signatures, defaults, return types, and exception behavior while internally delegating to the shared run_pass() helper
Mutating routes (bridge_sync, bridge_pause, bridge_resume, and legacy reconcile modes that mutate) must be gated by mcp.allow_jira_sync in MCP; read-only paths must not be rejected by this gate

The canonical disposition and exit-code classification must be extracted once from run_pass() as a typed result-bearing helper, then reused by library, MCP, and CLI without duplication or parallel implementations
New MCP tools must publish output schemas with typed inputs/results and pass schema parity checks; compatibility tools must retain their existing published schemas
Preview operations must never silently mutate, and sync operations must remain explicitly mutating; compatibility adapters must preserve old mutation boundaries and defaults
